en.d: Click your initials at the top-right corner of the screen.
Select "Club Settings" from the dropdown menu.
Scroll down the left sidebar to the ANALYTICS section and click "Reporting".
This is your reporting home: summary figures at the top, and four tabs below with the detail.
"Active coaches" and "Seats used" show how much of your licence is in use. "Coaches met" shows how many have hit their CPD target.
Switch between Coaches, Modules, Coach Groups and Events. Start with "Coaches" to review people.
Scroll right to see every metric: In Progress, Completed, Failed, Season CPD, Target Met, Lifetime CPD and Daily Visits.
Set a date range to report on a specific season or block, or search for one coach by name. "Clear filters" resets everything.
Click the coach's name to drill into their individual activity.

en.t: See what they have worked on
en.d: Every unit the coach has started, with its module, completion date, status and CPD time earned.
Click "Export" to download the report as a file — useful for sharing it or tracking progress over time.
Click any unit to see it video by video, marked "Watched" or "Unwatched" — so you know exactly where a coach stopped.

en.doneT: You know how to read the reports!
en.doneD: You can now track licence usage, CPD progress and individual coach activity, drill down to a single video, and export any view. Check back regularly to spot coaches who need a nudge.
